steps.subject: sky
steps.action: dab indian yellow and cad yellow into the sky, then yellow ochre
steps.load: small amount of color on the 2in
steps.motion: dab a little color here and there

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: dab a little alizarin crimson into the yellow for a warm glow
steps.load: a very small amount of crimson on the same brush
steps.motion: dab here and there, blend into a peach color

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: tap very light tree shapes far back
steps.load: a very small amount on the corner of the brush
steps.motion: tap basic tree shapes, very light
steps.rule: far things stay light and nearer things get darker

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: tap a subdued tree at the top corner
steps.load: same color with a touch more paint
steps.motion: tap basic shape at the top

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: build darker bush layers in front of the tree
steps.load: more paint on the same corner
steps.motion: tap layer after layer
steps.where: in front of the tree above it

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add a darker mix and tap more bush layers
steps.load: dark sienna and van dyke brown added to the mix
steps.motion: tap basic shapes, each layer darker

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap another bush, each layer darker
steps.load: same mix
steps.motion: tap further layers
steps.where: another bush on the other side

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: sparkle a bush with a little bright red
steps.load: a little bright red added
steps.motion: tap a bush

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap a dark value into the bush to add a layer
steps.load: a dark color loaded on the corner
steps.motion: tap a dark layer

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: tap another bush with a van dyke and dark sienna mix
steps.load: the mix loaded on the corner
steps.motion: tap a bush

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: draw thin sticks and twigs on the back trees
steps.load: bush color thinned with paint thinner
steps.motion: flowing sticks and twigs
steps.rule: thin paint flows over the bush layers without mixing

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: darken the front branches with a little van dyke brown
steps.load: same thin mix with van dyke brown added
steps.motion: draw darker branches

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: draw a big upright tree with branches in the center
steps.load: same brown mix
steps.motion: draw a big trunk going up, then a few sticks
steps.where: center of the canvas, a big tree

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: lay a dark undercolor for the shadows in the snow
steps.load: the dark mix from the liner
steps.motion: scatter a little color

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: load and pull white across the snow area
steps.load: thick white on both sides with the least touch of red
steps.motion: pull firmly across at an angle

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: tap a least touch of phthalo blue into the snow for a cool shadow
steps.load: least touch of blue on the 2in
steps.motion: tap in lightly, then gently pull to blend
steps.rule: blue cools the snow so it looks cooler

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: add a pure white bump so it stands out
steps.load: pure white on the 2in
steps.motion: pull a distinct bump
steps.where: a hill or bump in the snow

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull straight down for the reflection under the snow
steps.load: bright red and black mixed on the brush, with a touch of blue
steps.motion: pull straight down from the snow edge

steps.subject: water
steps.action: touch a least bit of yellow ochre into the water, away from the blue
steps.load: least touch on the brush
steps.motion: touch in spots
steps.where: water spots, away from the blue
steps.rule: keeping yellow off the blue keeps the water from going green

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull straight horizontal strokes across the water
steps.load: clean brush
steps.motion: pull straight across
steps.rule: straight strokes keep the water from looking tilted

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut a white water line along the snow edge with the knife
steps.load: thin roll of white and liquid white on the knife edge
steps.motion: cut in and push firmly
steps.rule: thin paint sticks to thick paint, so thin it first

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: cut a flat roll of van dyke brown for a tree trunk
steps.load: flat roll on the knife edge
steps.motion: cut straight down

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: fan on more van dyke brown for another tree
steps.load: fan loaded full with the same color
steps.motion: tap in a tree shape

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: make a thicker crooked tree with the fan
steps.load: thicker van dyke brown on the fan
steps.motion: tap a crooked trunk
steps.rule: thicker paint dries to feel like real bark

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: pull flat white on the knife for birch trees, lit from the left
steps.load: flat roll of white on the knife edge
steps.motion: touch and pull to form birch trees
steps.where: birch trees in the left of the scene

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add limbs to the old trees with the liner
steps.load: lots of thinned van dyke brown on the liner
steps.motion: flow limbs out from the trunks

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add limbs crossing the trunk, some going behind
steps.load: brown on the liner
steps.motion: draw limbs across and behind the trunk
steps.rule: limbs crossing the trunk and going behind look natural

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: clean up the small tree base with white
steps.load: a little white on the liner
steps.motion: clean up the little base strokes

steps.subject: land
steps.action: cut in a small bank and a reflection under it
steps.load: titanium white thinned with liquid white
steps.motion: lay a bank, then a reflection under it

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: paint a wiggly tree with a big arm and branches
steps.load: thinned on the liner, a lot of thinner
steps.motion: wiggly strokes for the tree and its big arm
steps.where: other side of the tree, big arm

steps.subject: snow
steps.action: flick thinned liquid white off the brush like salt
steps.load: liquid white thinned with paint thinner on the palette
steps.motion: flick specks off the knife edge
steps.rule: flicked specks soften the whole painting

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting in red
steps.load: red on the liner
steps.motion: write signature

rules: [21:14] knife made trunks dry thick and feel like real trees
